{{Quote|Why not? Do you fear you would lose such a contest?|Plo Koon, addressing Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during a High Council session, while overseeing the assault in the Ywllandr system|<ref name="ROTSn" />}}
A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Ywllandr system/Legends|Ywllandr system]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], during the final [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], as part of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. Following the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]&mdash;overseeing a small [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Courageous (Republic flagship)|''Courageous'']]&mdash;pursued [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] forces to the Ywllandr [[Star system/Legends|system]], which had been established as a choke point along the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]] to hinder Republic activity in the surrounding parts of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The ensuing [[Space warfare/Legends|engagement]] resulted in heavy fighting, with Koon eventually triumphing over the Confederate forces. His victory allowed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] detachment to move in and [[Battle of Mygeeto|assault]] the nearby [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], while Koon was reassigned to command a [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|campaign]] at [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].

==Prelude==
By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="ROTSn" /> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] took control of the [[Ywllandr system/Legends|Ywllandr system]] in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="CSWE: Ywllandr" /> In taking the [[Star system/Legends|star system]], which laid on the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Confederacy converted it into a choke point, forcing [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] that were bound for other areas of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to pass through the enemy-controlled system.<ref name="CSWE: Ywllandr" /> The system became an area of interest<ref name="TEA" /> when the Republic targeted Separatist holdings throughout the Outer Rim in a campaign termed the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Following the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy's]] retreat at the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]],<ref name="ROTS" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], led a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] strike force<ref name="ROTSn" /> in pursuit of the Separatists. His task force chased them from the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and along the Entralla Route to the Ywllandr system,<ref name="TEA" /> where they began an offensive to repel the Separatists from the system.<ref name="CSWE: Courageous">{{CSWECite|I|149|''Courageous'' (2)}}</ref>

==The battle==
[[File:PloKoonAndWolffe-RM.png|thumb|left|250px|General Plo Koon oversaw the Republic's assault in the Ywllandr system.]]
Commanding his small fleet<ref name="CSWE: Ywllandr" /> from the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the Republic [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Courageous (Republic flagship)|''Courageous'']],<ref name="ROTSn" /><ref name="CSWE: Courageous" /> Koon oversaw the Republic's [[Space warfare/Legends|assault]] on the Confederate forces, focusing on breaking the Ywllandr system's choke point.<ref name="ROTSn" /> During the heavy fighting that followed,<ref name="CSWE: Ywllandr" /> Koon participated in a meeting with the other [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] via [[holograph]]ic connection from ''Courageous''{{'s}} bridge, regarding their plan to have [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="ROTSn" /> His fleet eventually overpowered the Separatist defenses, severing their hold on the system.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Execute Order 66.''"<br />"''It will be done, my lord.|On the orders of Chancellor Palpatine, Captain Jag prepares to execute Plo Koon over Cato Neimoidia|<ref name="ROTS" />}}
[[File:Plokoonjsf.png|thumb|right|250px|Captain Jag prepares to execute Koon over Cato Neimoidia as part of Order 66.]]
Koon's victory in the Ywllandr system allowed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi's]] [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] to reach the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]],<ref name="Warfare" /> which&mdash;being a major holding of the Separatist-allied [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]&mdash;was another target in the Republic's Outer Rim campaign.<ref name="DB Mygeeto">{{DB|location|mygeeto|Mygeeto}}</ref> The world had been mired in [[Battle of Mygeeto|conflict]] since [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], two years prior.<ref name="CE" /><ref name="True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> While Mundi staged an assault on Mygeeto with his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] and the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]],<ref name="ROTS" /><ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> Koon meanwhile assumed command of Republic forces on the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Purse world/Legends|purse world]] of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] stronghold that was [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|resisting]] Republic control<ref name="DB Cato Neimoidia">{{DB|location|catoneimoidia|Cato Neimoidia}}</ref> despite its [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|defeat]] a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] earlier.<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> Koon was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] following [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] issuance of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], a secret [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|directive]] for [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to execute their Jedi [[Commander/Legends|commanders]]. [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Jai'galaar (clone)|Jag]] [[Starfighter combat/Legends|shot down]] the Jedi Master's [[Plo Koon's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 starfighter]] during an aerial patrol of one of Cato Neimoidia's [[Bridge city/Legends|bridge cities]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In the New Territories, Plo Koon broke the Separatist defenses at Ywllandr, clearing the way for Ki-Adi-Mundi's forces to assault the key InterGalactic Banking Clan world of Mygeeto.|Excerpt from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''{{'s}} section on the Outer Rim Sieges|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
The battle of the Ywllandr system was created for the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which was authored by [[Matthew Stover]] and published on [[April 2]], [[2005]]. It was referred to in passing in the novel,<ref name="ROTSn" /> not being alluded to in the film itself, which was released on [[May 19]] of the same year.<ref name="ROTS" />
